tells: 1. Faces are front-lit evenly bright despite a dark candle-lit house: no motivated key, no falloff across the face, skin reads as flat orange diffuse with no subsurface or specular breakup; the front row glows like it is under a softbox that does not exist in the room (club-1-wide.png, centre front row; club-3-mid.png, centre faces)

2. Face close is a game cutscene: waxy uniform skin, painted-on brows, glassy fixed eyes with no catchlight from the candles, a hard dark outline halo around the head and shoulders from the DOF compositing (club-4-face.png, whole face and silhouette edge)

3. Back of the room is a wall of flat black cut-out silhouettes standing in haze with identical grey value; real haze would show rim and partial fill, not paper cut-outs (club-1-wide.png and club-2-mid.png, upper middle band)

4. Candles on every table are bright but throw no warm pool on hands, tabletops or chins; table surfaces are uniform matte brown with no specular, so the practicals are unmotivated decoration (club-6-held.png, centre table and hands at lower centre)

5. Strip: between 12.0 and 13.0 s only heads turn and one woman lifts a hand; shoulders, chests and the rest of the room are frozen, no breathing or bounce, so the start of a laugh reads as rigged puppets rotating necks (club-5-strip.png, all six frames, front row)

1. Lighting is a flat front wash on rows 0-1 with no source in frame and no fall-off within a body: front row lit uniformly head to shoe while the row directly behind drops to murk, like a spotlight volume rather than a stage spill; whites (sneakers, jeans) clip and look pasted (theatre-1-wide.png, front row lower centre; theatre-6-held.png same)

2. Back rows are a uniformly spaced grid of identical-scale people standing or floating against a black void with no visible seats or rake; several upper figures stand stiff in seat positions, so depth and scale read as cards stacked in space (theatre-1-wide.png, upper two thirds)

3. Face close: plastic skin with no pores, mouth interior is a dark dented cavity, eyes unfocused and mismatched, hard black outline around the hood and earrings from the bokeh composite (theatre-4-face.png, mouth and outer silhouette)

4. Contact: people sit on red seats without compressing them, hands hover on knees, legs and seat edges intersect; the second-row bodies overlap seat backs with no occlusion shadow (theatre-2-mid.png, centre and right; theatre-3-mid.png, front row seats)

5. Strip: a laugh start shows only small head yaws and an opened mouth on two people; torsos locked, nobody leans or shakes; the dark-haired man at right abruptly snaps hair/head between frames, reading as a pose swap not motion (theatre-5-strip.png, frames 12.6-13.0, right of centre)

1. Faces and shirts are lit bright and flat from the camera axis while the downlights are behind the audience on the far wall; no rim from those cans, no backlight on hair, so the key is unmotivated (openmic-2-mid.png, all faces; openmic-1-wide.png, front row)

2. Face close is CG: smooth airbrushed skin with uniform orange tint, flat lit iris, hair as a stiff helmet with stair-stepped card edges at the nape, and a dark halo line along the jaw/hood from the DOF matte (openmic-4-face.png, hair at right, jaw edge, left shoulder)

3. Mid shots: several women have a dark fringe/eyebrow band and black teeth/mouth blobs that read as texture errors; the necklace is painted on, fabric has no folds responding to posture (openmic-2-mid.png, right-of-centre woman's face; openmic-3-mid.png centre woman)

4. Wide is a dim grey-brown box with black void ceiling and silhouettes in the back half; the left doorway is a flat lit rectangle; exposure lifts the crowd while the room is murky, with no haze or bounce linking them (openmic-1-wide.png, left wall door and upper half)

5. Strip: head turns and mouth opens are visible, but the bodies stay pinned, hands rest identically on knees in all six frames and the man at left stays static; the onset of a laugh has no breath, shoulder lift or forward lean (openmic-5-strip.png, all frames, hands and torsos)
